channel.description: The Night Final: the week’s Batman news. Every Sunday, late.

item.title: No. 1 · Clayface has a final trailer. The R is still not the studio's.
item.description: The week came in with the names first. The pages that should have held the dates did not all agree.

item.title: No. 0 · Somebody has to stay up with Batman, and we will
item.description: Sunday before the wire starts. No listing moved, and the paper still owes you a first night: who we are, who this is for, and the map next door.
